summary: Found live 2026-07-29 while validating MPI-394 on a fresh CPU Pod: the user pressed Install on SDXL NSFW and the tile sat on 'Queued...' with nothing else installing. Proven from the live app: /comfy/downloads/status held NO sdxl-nsfw job at all (only engine:assets and klein-4b, both complete) and /comfy/downloads/active returned {models:[],engine:false} - so the POST never fired. Installs are serialised through a client-side promise chain gated on _inFlight (downloadService.js:76, MPI-184); 'queued' is only set when _inFlight > 0, so something held the chain. The only other start() in the session was engine:assets (drift heal logged nothing, no generation ran, App Library never opened) - so its chain link had not settled DESPITE download:complete having fired, which the completion toast proves. That is only possible if the listener was armed after the event. Root: run() armed _awaitDownloadDone INSIDE the post-POST .then(), but routes/downloadManager.js calls _startPendingDeps() BEFORE res.json() (register-before-respond, G8) and a fully-satisfied install goes terminal right there - 0 queued deps, nothing to download. The terminal broadcast therefore beats a listener armed after await res.json(). _awaitDownloadDone then burns its full 30-MINUTE ceiling with _inFlight pinned at 1, and every install clicked in that window sits at 'queued' forever - with no revert timer, because downloadService.js:90 arms one only for 'pending'. SHIPS TO USERS: _installRemoteEngineAssets re-runs on the first connect of EVERY session and is a pure no-op once the volume already holds the weights, so the common case (any session after the first) is the one that wedges, and the victim is the first model install after connecting to a Pod. NOT caused by the earlier volume-full session; a fresh volume would HIDE it, because a real 1.76GB download always lands after the listener is armed. Second, cosmetic half of the same trigger: notificationService announced 'engine:assets installed.' - a raw internal job id - as a toast and, unfocused, an OS notification, on every connect, even though shell.js states the heal must run silently.

Fix shipped: listener armed before the POST, cancel path for an unfired POST, safety ceiling logs, engine:assets suppressed in notificationService. Suite 293/293, eslint clean, negative control 1/4 pass unfixed vs 4/4 fixed.
Needs the live Pod check: connect, then install a model - it must start, not queue.

USER-VERIFIED LIVE on the two headline items, after a renderer reload (both fixes are renderer files; the reload also reset shell.js _didFirstConnectDriftCheck, so the reconnect genuinely re-ran the engine-asset heal - the wedge condition). (1) No engine:assets toast on the reconnect, and the heal definitely ran, so that is the suppression working rather than the heal being skipped. (2) The install started immediately - SDXL Realistic went straight to a live bar at 243.5 MB/s, 0.9/9.0GB, footer on Cancel, and ran to completion; pre-fix the same click parked on Queued with no server-side job at all. THREE RESIDUALS still unexercised live: the legitimate queue (second install must read Queued then start - now cheap, the uninstall freed ~9GB), cancel-while-queued (the new done.cancel() path, the one piece of the fix with no live coverage), and the OS notification when unfocused. Card stays doing/validating on those.

Three residuals run live on CPU Pod omi9588i0gymlu. Legitimate queue read Queued...; cancel-while-queued released the chain (proven by the next POST reaching the server at 20:36:04, seconds after the click, rather than parking for 30 minutes); the 400 volume-full rejection that followed is the correct pre-flight, not a defect; no engine:assets OS notification on the unfocused reconnect. Client-side queue is invisible to /comfy/downloads/status by design, so the timing log carries residuals 1-2.
All five acceptance items have live evidence; user approved close.
